works.body: ペブルズさん、こんにちは。最近抱いているいくつかの思いを絵に描いてほしいのです。自由に解釈してください。体がバラバラに崩れていくような気がします。毎日、疲れと痛みで目が覚めます。頭はズキズキと痛み、肺はゼイゼイと音を立て、腸は結び目になるように引っ張られているようです。世界は騒音の霞を通して見え、耳鳴りはどんどん大きくなっていきます。 言葉が詰まり、正しい言葉を探そうとすると脳が固まってしまう。思考がまとまりにくく、複雑なことは理解できなくなる。ようやく眠りにつくと、力尽きたように感じる。目を閉じ、無の境地が私を包み込むことを願う。あなたの描くものを楽しみにしています！！

Hello! I've been a fan of your work for a while and I've never used SKEB before so I hope I'm doing everything right, but thought to take my chance after seeing you open !! My userame is Yuwuki1 but you may call me Nai!

I wanted to know if you'd be okay drawing my alien character here! ( You may use the colored reference )
They wear a mask with piercings on the outside, never show their face and are pretty tall. They dress pretty wild and love cool patterns...

 I marked the commission as NSFW due to  their nudity, but you don't have to draw anything directly sexual with them! I give you free reign on stylizing their design and composition! I'm not very picky and trust your design sense! I love the surreal environments you depict and the world they live in is very similar, with a very dreamlike and musical feeling...I'd love for something with them in  scene playing a daegeum/flute while herding some cows/sheep like a pied piper, or with a gombangdae/korean smoking pipe. They farm and tend to smoke on the job...
Their mask does have a small hole by its mouth so it's fine to draw the pipe over it if chosen

If you accept, thank you and I'd definitely come back in the future if accepted!! Have a good day!
